duration.text: The Chinese language program at South China Normal University is a 1 Year long program for international students, taught in Chinese.

fees.text: Application Fee: $ 150 USD Service Fee: $ 50 USD Tuition fee: $ 2291 USD/per year ￥ 16500 CNY/per year

materials.text: Have a high school diploma or above equivalent to that in China.The original of the final academic certificate or a notarized copy. For fresh graduates, the original of the expected graduation certificate is required. For texts other than Chinese or English, notarized Chinese or English translations must also be provided.The original transcript of all courses in the final academic education stage or a notarized copy. For texts other than Chinese or English, notarized Chinese or English translations must also be provided.A valid HSK certificate or transcript (if any).A scanned copy of the first page of a passport valid for more than six months.Scanned copies of all visas on this passport (if any).A recent 6-month, bareheaded, front-facing, single-person standard ID photo (the same size as the passport photo)

requirements.text: Admission target: Non-Chinese citizens holding valid ordinary foreign passports and having studied the language in China for no more than one year.Age requirement: 18-40 years old (Applicants for scholarship programs must meet the age requirements of each program).Physical condition: Good health, meeting the physical examination standards for applying for a study visa to China.Moral cultivation: Be friendly to China, have good conduct, abide by laws and regulations, respect the customs and habits of the Chinese people, and have no record of illegal or disciplinary violations.Financial situation: Be able to guarantee the payment of corresponding tuition fees, accommodation fees and daily living expenses.
